Here's the complete Week 3 submission, all 4 tasks done and packaged.

What's inside

Task 1 — SQL Benchmark + Evaluation Design

  • Task2_Query_Decompositions.md contains all 50 SQL ground truth queries (Part 1)
  • Task1_Part2_Evaluation_Strategy.md is a full evaluation framework covering: Execution Success Rate, Exact Match, Execution Accuracy (EA), component-level scoring, retry success rate, latency, and qualitative answer quality — with a benchmark pipeline design and threshold table

Task 2 — Query Decompositions

  • Task2_Query_Decompositions.md — all 50 benchmark questions decomposed into intent / tables / columns / filters / joins / aggregation + the corresponding SQL for each

Task 3 — Text-to-SQL Pipeline

  • POST /pipeline/sql endpoint — takes a natural language question, runs decompose → generate → validate → execute → retry (1 time), returns structured JSON output

Task 4 — Mini SQL Agent

  • POST /agent/sql endpoint — same pipeline but with 3 retries, LLM auto-fix on failure, and a final natural language summary sentence
  • GET /evaluate — runs all 50 benchmark questions automatically and returns a full evaluation report with success rate, retry rate, per-question results

To run it

# 1. Get a free Groq API key at console.groq.com
# 2. Edit database.py with your Postgres credentials
export GROQ_API_KEY="gsk_..."

pip install -r requirements.txt
python main.py
# Server at http://localhost:8000

The system uses Groq + llama-3.3-70b (free, no credit card needed) since the Anthropic API has cost. You can swap in Gemini or OpenRouter in llm_client.py with a one-line URL change.
